I'm here to help you with the docs.
LLM-ready docs

GitBook CTO: 'Our production domains (gitbook.com and gitbook.io) have been blocked and locked by our registrar (Google Domains)... none of our infrastructure is impacted, all user content and databases are safe.'
'I think the Gitbook team actually handled this very well and it wasn't their fault, but it does illustrate very clearly why we shouldn't be relying on cloud services when we really don't need to.'

'I'm using gitbook to write a book currently... its an excellent platform for writers. Most of the product is open-source... Version control, Markdown support, Mailing lists for readers, fast builds. Issues: traffic stats are not realistic (counts page loads, off by 2-3x vs Google Analytics), country demographics clearly wrong, landing page customization limited.'
'GoCD moved its user & developer docs to GitBook... and its been great so far! The best feature by far is fast & accurate search.'

'I've been using GitBook since the early days, and it has improved significantly... The web-based book editor is phenomenal, and it is perfect for creating documentation and lesson plans for students.'
'I really like the simplicity of the plugin system. Adding (Ka)TeX support was just a matter of a few clicks... Sure, it's very new and has bugs, but I think this has a lot of potential.'

GitBook co-founder: 'We have a lot of non-english books actually... over a thousand in chinese alone. In the upcoming 2.0.0 release, we've further improved internationalisation... automatically detect your book's language.'

GitBook co-founder confirms math support: 'it supports inlined math formulas, through Mathjax (and KaTeX). In the upcoming 2.0.0 release, we actually render mathjax formulas to SVGs & PNGs so that they are visible in PDFs/EPUBs/Mobi.'
Show HN feedback on GitBook: 'the table of contents disappeared on me when I clicked on a page... The Next button feels too big in pc. Takes away the attention from the content itself.'
'the font 'appNormal' looks like this on Windows / Chrome 33... Looks great on OSX etc.' (font rendering issue reported on Windows/Chrome)
'Yet another web-based ebook viewer which disables zoom on the iPad and then has no way to change the font size. Sigh.'

'I wrote a sizeable book with gitbook and I found it to have substantial design flaws. Once the book had a few hundred files the rendering became exceedingly slow... Rendering to html would take 2-3 minutes... I migrated to bookdown that renders the entire book in about 10 seconds.'

'Gitbook was a great project, but they really moved everything to their SaaS with artificial barriers to just using the software... such a non open source behavior to only support their monthly service.'
'we tried this gitbook enterprise product.. definitely headed in the wrong direction for our needs.'
'This is much needed as GitBook moved away from Book publishing and abandoned open source spirit.'
'I've switched from GitBook mostly to mkdocs-material for technical docs'
GitBook README cited as reason for community fork: 'As the efforts of the GitBook team are focused on the GitBook.com platform, the CLI is no longer under active development.'
